title: feat(f4): implement administrator user management and integrated verification (P11-P12)
body:
## Overview (Phase F4: P11–P12)
Implements Major Phase F4 capabilities for TokTickIT Lab 3 (Work Packages P11 and P12):
- **P11 (Administrator User Management):**
  - Administrative User REST APIs: `GET /api/admin/users`, `POST /api/admin/users`, `PATCH /api/admin/users/:id`, and `POST /api/admin/users/:id/initial-password`.
  - Administrative Safety Invariants:
    - **Self-Deactivation Guard (BR-19):** Blocks administrator from deactivating their own account (HTTP 400 `SELF_DEACTIVATION`).
    - **Last Active Admin Guard (BR-20):** Blocks deactivating or demoting the last active administrator (HTTP 400 `LAST_ACTIVE_ADMIN`).
    - **Owner Deactivation Cascade (BR-21):** Automatically unassigns tickets (`ownerId: null`), increments `version`, and returns `unassignedTicketsCount` when an owner is deactivated or demoted.
    - **Session Revocation (AC-53):** Purges all active sessions upon role change, deactivation, or password reset.
  - Frontend Screen 5 (`UserManagement.tsx`): Full user directory with debounced search, role filter, responsive table, Add User modal, Edit User modal (with disabled self-deactivation and last-admin warning), and Reset Password modal with session revocation warning.
- **P12 (Integrated Verification & Visual Evidence):**
  - Full Playwright E2E verification across Desktop (1280x800), Tablet (768x1024), and Mobile (375x667) viewports.
  - Automated visual screenshots captured to `artifacts/lab-03/screenshots/`.

## Acceptance Criteria Covered
- **AC-20 to AC-27:** Admin user list, search, filter, and user provisioning with forced password change.
- **AC-32 to AC-35:** Admin user editing and administrative password reset.
- **AC-49 to AC-56:** Integrated system verification, multi-viewport UI responsiveness, and session invalidation.
- **BR-19, BR-20, BR-21:** Self-deactivation, last active admin protection, and owner cascade unassignment.

## Verification Results
- **Full Server Test Suite:** 25 files, 246/246 tests passed (0 failed, 0 skipped) in 43.7s.
- **Full Client Test Suite:** 15 files, 80/80 tests passed (0 failed, 0 skipped) in 19.5s.
- **Full Lab 3 Playwright E2E Suite:** 4 spec files, 69/69 tests passed across Desktop, Tablet, and Mobile in 1.6m.
- **Production Builds:** Server (`tsc`) and Client (`tsc && vite build`) compiled with 0 errors.

> **Note on Branching Contract:** This PR targets `lab3-staging`. As required by project rules, Issue #42 is explicitly linked in the Development panel below.

title: feat(f3): implement Phase F3 requester regression, staff queue, triage operations, and communication (P07-P10)
body:
## Overview (Phase F3: P07–P10)
Implements Major Phase F3 capabilities for TokTickIT Lab 3 (Work Packages P07, P08, P09, P10):

- **P07 Requester Regression:** Upgrades Lab 2 requester endpoints to rely on session-authenticated identity instead of `X-Requester-Id` headers, while preserving complete regression compatibility for ticket creation, listing, detail, and attachments.
- **P08 Staff Queue:** Multi-filter triage dashboard (`GET /api/staff/tickets`) with full-text search, status, priority, and ownership filters. Fully responsive with desktop table and mobile card views.
- **P09 Staff Operations:** Claim unassigned, owner reassignment, IT priority updates, and status transitions following the 8-state lifecycle. Enforces **atomic optimistic concurrency locking** (`where: { id, version: expectedVersion }`) returning 409 `CONFLICT` on race conditions, plus write-time active owner eligibility checks.
- **P10 Communication & Admin Read-Only Detail:** Append-only public comments, confidential internal notes (403 for requesters), "Problem Appears Resolved" requester flow, and Admin read-only detail view (`/admin/tickets/:id`) with suppressed operations and comment forms.

title: Phase F2 / P03: Additive Data Migration, Schema Expansion & Idempotent Seeding (LCP-02)
body:
### Summary
This issue covers Work Package P03 (part of Major Phase F2: Database & Authentication System) on branch `feature/f2-p03-data-migration`:
- **Prisma Schema Expansion (LCP-02):** Additive data model migration introducing `User` (mapping legacy `RequesterUser`), `Role` (`REQUESTER`, `IT_STAFF`, `ADMINISTRATOR`), `Session`, 8-state `TicketStatus`, `PublicComment`, and `InternalNote`.
- **Legacy Data Preservation (R05, R12):** Zero data loss for Lab 2 tickets, categories, attachments, and priorities; preserve `ticketNo`, `ticketOwnerId`, `itPriority`.
- **Idempotent Seed Script (R13, R14):** Seeding default users (Admin, Staff, Requesters) with hashed credentials and `mustChangePassword: true`, plus reference fixtures.

### Scope & Planned Deliverables
1. **Additive Prisma Schema (`server/prisma/schema.prisma`):**
   - Expand `TicketStatus` to 8 values (`NEW`, `OPEN`, `IN_PROGRESS`, `WAITING_FOR_REQUESTER`, `RESOLVED`, `CLOSED`, `REOPENED`, `CANCELLED`).
   - Add `Role` enum (`REQUESTER`, `IT_STAFF`, `ADMINISTRATOR`).
   - Update user model (`User` mapping `RequesterUser`) with `role`, `passwordHash`, `mustChangePassword`, `sessionVersion`, `isActive`.
   - Add `Session` model for server-side PostgreSQL sessions.
   - Add `PublicComment` and `InternalNote` models (append-only relations).
   - Add `appearsResolvedAt` and `appearsResolvedById` on `Ticket`.
2. **Database Migration:**
   - Execute Prisma migration generating clean SQL without dropping tables or columns.
3. **Idempotent Seed (`server/prisma/seed.ts`):**
   - Seed accounts with secure password hashes.
   - Support running multiple times without throwing unique constraint errors or duplicating records.
4. **Automated Migration Tests (`server/tests/lab-03/migration-regression.test.ts`):**
   - **MIG-01 (AC-14):** Verify legacy table counts, IDs, FKs, and `ticketNo` preserved post-migration.
   - **MIG-02 (AC-15):** Apply migration chain on fresh DB and populated DB.
   - **MIG-03 (AC-16):** Run seed script twice sequentially (idempotency).
   - **MIG-04 (AC-17):** Verify legacy requesters have provisioned credentials and forced change flag.
   - **MIG-05 (AC-31):** Verify `itPriority` values are preserved.

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Prisma schema expands cleanly with backward compatibility for Lab 2 endpoints and queries.
- [ ] Seed script executes idempotently with safe password hashing.
- [ ] All 5 planned migration tests (MIG-01 through MIG-05) pass.
- [ ] Existing Lab 2 client and server unit tests pass without regression.
- [ ] PR targets `lab3-staging` and is linked via Development panel.

title: feat(test-harness): implement Phase F1 test isolation harness, safety guards, and peer review hardening (Issue #36)
body:
## Summary
This Pull Request implements and hardens Major Phase F1 (Work Packages P00–P02: Baseline, Specification, and Test Isolation Harness) for Lab 3, addressing all peer review findings on branch `feature/f1-prep-and-test-harness` (Resolves #36).

## Key Deliverables & Hardening Pass
1. **Database & Environment Guards (LCP-01, HARNESS-01):**
   - Implemented fail-closed test environment guards in `server/src/config/testEnvironment.ts` and `server/scripts/run-tests.mjs` requiring `DATABASE_URL_TEST` targeting `toktickit_test` or `toktickit_test_<suffix>`. Refuses execution against ambient/dev database.
   - Enforced strict attachment directory isolation (`assertContained`) within `server/test-uploads/<runId>` to eliminate path traversal risks.

   - Zero environment state leakage (`PLAYWRIGHT_IS_PROBE` removed).
3. **Shared Containment Cleanup & Failure Simulation:**
   - Single source of truth helper `cleanupAttachmentFiles` used by both E2E `test.afterAll` and integration tests.
   - Simulated physical unlink error (`EPERM`) verifying cleanup failures fail test runs visibly per HARNESS-01.
4. **Lab 3 Five-Major-Phase Architecture:**

title: Phase F1 (P00–P02): Test Isolation Harness, Safety Guards, and Peer Review Hardening (LCP-01)
body:
### Summary
This issue covers Major Phase F1 (Work Packages P00–P02) for TokTickIT Lab 3 on branch `feature/f1-prep-and-test-harness`:
- **P00 (Baseline):** Complete regression baseline inspection against Lab 2 specification, API, UI, and test suites.
- **P01 (Specification & LCPs):** Finalize Lab 3 engineering specification, API spec, UI spec, and Legacy Change Proposals (LCP-01 through LCP-06).
- **P02 (Test Isolation Harness & Safety Guards — LCP-01):** Implement strict fail-closed database guards, isolated test upload directories with path traversal protection, runtime Playwright CLI guards, probe-only webServer skip restriction, and shared containment cleanup with simulated physical unlink failure verification.

### Scope & Delivered Components
1. **Database & Environment Guards (LCP-01, HARNESS-01):**
   - `server/src/config/testEnvironment.ts` & `server/scripts/run-tests.mjs`: Require `DATABASE_URL_TEST` matching `/^toktickit_test(?:_[a-z0-9_]+)?$/i` before any test execution. Ambient or development databases (`toktickit`) fail closed immediately.
   - `assertContained` & `resolveUploadDir`: Enforce strict containment of attachment files within `server/test-uploads/<runId>`. Prevent path traversal (`..` or escaped paths).
   - `validateApiEndpoint` & `resolveApiBase`: Prevent API port fallback to development port 3000 during test execution; enforce port 3001.
2. **Playwright Worker & WebServer Hardening (`playwright.config.ts`):**
   - Synchronize test environment (`TOKTICKIT_TEST_RUN_ID`, `SCREENSHOT_DIR`, `API_URL`, `VITE_API_URL`) from Playwright config to workers.
   - Restrict `PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_WEBSERVER` strictly to probe test (`e2e/lab-03/worker-env.spec.ts`) using exact path resolution (`isProbeFile`); fail closed with exception on any general or non-probe test run (including files with "probe" substring).
   - Zero environment state mutation (`process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_IS_PROBE` removed).
3. **Shared Containment Cleanup & Verification:**
   - Centralized `cleanupAttachmentFiles` helper shared between `requester-ticket-flow.spec.ts` (`afterAll`) and integration tests.
   - Unit test simulating physical unlink failure (`EPERM`) proving cleanup failures fail the test run visibly per HARNESS-01.
4. **Documentation & Traceability:**
   - 5-Major-Phase structure (F1–F5) established in `docs/lab-03/PHASES.md`, `AGENTS.md`, and `.antigravityrules`.
   - Complete implementation records in `docs/lab-03/implementation-log.md`, `docs/lab-03/whatihavedone1.md`, `docs/lab-03/ai1.md`, and `docs/lab-03/aiused1.md`.

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Reviewer verifies database isolation: tests refuse to run against ambient/dev database without valid `DATABASE_URL_TEST`.
- [ ] Reviewer verifies file isolation: attachments are strictly scoped to run-specific directory with traversal prevention.
- [ ] Playwright worker environment propagation is proven via CLI execution without dependency on build artifacts.
- [ ] WebServer skip is strictly restricted to probe test via exact path resolution; non-probe runs fail closed.
- [ ] HARNESS-01 suite passes 24/24 tests with zero skips.
- [ ] Client test suite passes 37/37 tests; server and client TypeScript builds pass with 0 errors.
- [ ] Status gate: Major Phase F1 remains `In progress — P02 review fixes applied` until disposable DB is provided for full server/Playwright suites.
- [ ] Feature PR targets `lab3-staging`, is linked to this issue via Development panel, and is approved/merged by peer reviewer.

## Summary
Implements and hardens **Phase 3 — Create Ticket** for TokTickIT Lab 2 Requester Ticketing MVP according to the canonical contracts (`specification.md`, `api-spec.md`, `ui-spec.md`, and `tests.md` v1.1.0).

  - Ticket number generation with up to 3 collision retries before returning flat `500` without stack traces.
  - Enforces `currentStatus = NEW`, `itPriority = requestedPriority`, and `ticketOwnerId = null`.

- Added `CreateTicket` screen with two-column responsive grid layout per `ui-spec.md` Section 10.2.
- Implemented read-only system headers (`tabIndex={-1}`) with placeholders and requester profile.
- Enforced client-side attachment staging (upload deferred to Phase 5):
  - Strictly checks file extension including dot notation (rejects extensionless files).
  - Exact error copy for > 5 MB, invalid types, and > 5 files.
  - Proves zero upload/network calls during Phase 3 staging.
- Made entire form read-only/disabled during submission with busy spinner state.
- Preserves all entered values and staged attachments on API failure.

Implements Phase 2 — Development Requester Context for the TokTickIT Lab 2 Requester Ticketing MVP.

This PR also includes an audit update that aligns the Lab 2 contract, test plan, build skill, and supporting evidence documents to version `1.1.0`.

## Backend

- Implemented `GET /api/requesters/active`.
- Returns active Requesters ordered by ascending ID.
- Implemented shared `requireRequester` middleware.
- Missing `X-Requester-Id` returns `401`.
- Malformed `X-Requester-Id` returns `400`.
- Inactive Requester returns `401`.
- Error responses use the API-contract message and body shape.
- Tests locate seeded Requesters by stable email instead of assuming fixed database IDs.

## Frontend

- Added the Development Requester selection screen.
- Added loading, success, empty, and API-failure states.
- Added wording explaining that the selector is for development/testing and is not real authentication.
- Added `RequesterContext` with `localStorage` persistence.
- Added `RouteGuard` for requester-scoped routes.
- Added `AppShell` with the selected Requester profile and Change action.
- Updated API calls to honor `VITE_API_URL`.
- Added the required Zen Green UI foundation.
- Enabled TypeScript `noEmit` to prevent build artifacts from being written into source folders.

## Contract and Workflow Audit

Updated the following Lab 2 artifacts to version `1.1.0`:

- `specification.md`
- `api-spec.md`
- `ui-spec.md`
- `tests.md`
- `lab2-toktickit-build/SKILL.md`
- Phase 2 implementation, test, file-change, AI-use, and pipeline reports

The update:

- clarifies the Phase 3/Phase 5 attachment boundary;
- replaces placeholder test paths with repository paths;
- completes the Acceptance Criteria and Business Rule traceability;
- adds the Phase 7 Playwright and screenshot workflow;
- requires final verification on `main`; and
- prevents retrospective or fabricated TDD Red evidence.

- Ticket-number generation retries only Prisma `P2002` collisions involving `ticketNo`.

- React displays the categories returned by the API, not hard-coded values
- Loading and error states are shown
- A Vitest test verifies the category-list UI behavior

title: Issue 3: Create and seed IT request categories
body:

- A Prisma Category model exists with id, unique name, and createdAt

title: Issue 2: Implement the API health check
